systems.name: World
systems.lane: per-frame call from Worlds::step (WorldStepperSys in dynamical, ScenarioRunner::step headless)
systems.summary: One independent simulation: owns its registry, PhysicsWorld, WorldClock, WorldRng, WorldInfo and fixed-lane SystemSet; creates the template's entities and runs one fixed tick with the Act/Observe phases.

systems.name: Worlds
systems.summary: The worlds of a scene in index order (host context variable in dynamical); creates them with per-index seeds and steps them, in parallel on taskflow when given an executor.

systems.name: ScenarioRunner
systems.lane: called by TrainHost / WorldsEnvironment and tests
systems.summary: Headless scene driver: loads a scene, creates, preinits and inits its worlds, steps them and can restart them with another base seed.

systems.name: SceneLoader
systems.lane: one-shot call (loadScene) from Game::start, ScenarioRunner, tests
systems.summary: Loads a .scene.json with includes, variables, file references, prefabs and world templates into a SceneDef; validates every entity by emplacing its components in a scratch registry.

systems.name: Probe
systems.lane: per-frame call from Game::start, after post_tick
systems.summary: Behaviour probe: every probe_every frames writes one CSV row (frame, rank, entity, position, rotation) per host entity holding Transform (and RigidBody).

systems.name: TrainHost
systems.lane: main loop of dynamical_train (TrainHost::run from train_main.cpp)
systems.summary: dynamical_train's loop: mode bench/null/train, environment parameters, ML-Agents handshake and RESET/STEP/QUIT serving against a TrainerEnvironment.

systems.name: WorldsEnvironment
systems.summary: mode=train environment: one agent per world (its AgentIO), writes actions, steps one decision window of every world, and turns AgentIO outputs into AgentInfos and stats.

components.name: WorldClock
components.summary: A world's fixed tick length, decision period and tick counter.
components.description: World registry context variable emplaced by the World constructor from the template's "clock" block (worldClock(def)): dt = 1 / physics_hz, decision_period = physics_hz / control_hz. physics_hz defaults to 60, control_hz to physics_hz (0 means physics_hz); physics_hz must be a positive multiple of control_hz or a SceneError is thrown at <template>/clock. World::tick reads tick % decision_period to pick the Act (k == 0) and Observe (k == period - 1) phases, then increments tick. Read by PhysicsStep/WorldTerrain, the sphere roller systems, WorldStepperSys (world 0's dt) and WorldsEnvironment (decision_period). Units: seconds, ticks.

fields.name: dt
fields.desc: fixed tick length in seconds, 1 / physics_hz

fields.name: decision_period
fields.desc: ticks per decision window, physics_hz / control_hz

fields.name: tick
fields.desc: ticks done since creation; incremented after each World::tick

components.name: WorldRng
components.summary: The world's own deterministic random stream (mt19937_64 with platform-independent distributions).
components.description: World registry context variable emplaced by the World constructor, seeded worldSeed(base_seed, index) (splitmix64-based). Its distributions are implemented by hand so results do not depend on the standard library: uniform() uses the top 53 bits of one engine draw, normal() is Box-Muller from two uniforms (u1 clamped to >= 1e-300, one draw pair per call, the second value discarded), unitSphere() draws z then an angle. Consumers: BoxDropSys::init, the sphere roller code (goal and speed draws, stagger), RigidBodySys::createGrounds (one raw engine() draw for a HeightField with seed 0). HeightField generation also constructs a local WorldRng from an explicit seed.

fields.name: engine
fields.desc: raw engine; uniform/normal/unitSphere draw from it

components.name: WorldInfo
components.summary: A world's index, seed and template name.
components.description: World registry context variable emplaced by the World constructor and never changed afterwards. index is the world's position in Worlds (global across all world entries of the scene), seed the value passed to WorldRng, template_name the template without the @<entry> suffix of per-entry variable resolution. Read by resetSphereEpisode in logic/agents/sphere_roller.cpp (spawn centre x = index * spawn_spacing).

fields.name: index
fields.desc: world index in the scene, 0-based

fields.name: seed
fields.desc: worldSeed(base_seed, index)

fields.name: template_name
fields.desc: world template name, '@<n>' suffix dropped

components.name: Worlds
components.summary: The scene's worlds, in index order (host context variable in dynamical).
components.description: Emplaced in the host registry by Game::start only when the scene has worlds; filled by Worlds::create(scene, RunArgs::seed), then preinit/init with the host systems, and finished in ~Game. Not copyable. ScenarioRunner owns its own Worlds member (not in a registry). Read by WorldStepperSys (steps it), WorldViewSys, SphereViewSys, RollerPlayerSys and ModelWatcherSys (which inserts a PolicyHandle into each world registry).

fields.name: list
fields.desc: the worlds; index i holds WorldInfo.index == i

components.name: RunArgs
components.summary: Parsed key=value process arguments: scene, variables, mode, capture and probe settings.
components.description: Produced by parseRunArgs (argv[0] skipped). In dynamical it is emplaced in the host registry by the Game constructor; dynamical_train keeps it as a local and passes it to TrainHost. With capture or probe set, fixed_frame_dt defaults to 1/60 and window_hidden to true unless given. deterministic() is fixed_frame_dt > 0 and switches off wall-clock use (frame clock, physics timings), asynchronous terrain generation and collider prefetch. Read via ctx().find by Renderer, Windu, UISys, the physics systems (deterministic() helper in physics_sys.cpp), ChunkGeneratorSys::tick and ModelWatcherSys::tick.

fields.name: scene
fields.desc: scene=: scene name or .json path; empty: base (dynamical) / walker_train or null (dynamical_train)

fields.name: vars
fields.desc: var.<name>=<value>, command-line order, last wins

fields.name: mode
fields.desc: mode=: dynamical_train bench | null | train (empty: train)

fields.name: threads
fields.desc: threads= >= 0: worker threads (bench, train)

fields.name: ticks
fields.desc: ticks= >= 0: dynamical exits after this many frames when > 0; bench tick count (600 when 0)

fields.name: episodes
fields.desc: episodes= >= 0; parsed but not read by code in this area

fields.name: seed
fields.desc: seed= >= 0: base seed of the worlds in dynamical

fields.name: capture
fields.desc: capture=: capture script (JSON)

fields.name: capture_dir
fields.desc: capture_dir=: output directory of the PNGs

fields.name: fixed_frame_dt
fields.desc: fixed_frame_dt= >= 0, decimal or fraction a/b; > 0 makes the frame clock ignore the wall clock

fields.name: window_hidden
fields.desc: window_hidden=true|false|1|0

fields.name: exit_after_capture
fields.desc: exit_after_capture=: quit when the capture script is done

fields.name: probe
fields.desc: probe=: CSV output file of the Probe

fields.name: probe_entities
fields.desc: probe_entities=: RigidBody or Transform (validated by Probe)

fields.name: probe_every
fields.desc: probe_every= > 0: sampling period in frames
